items.title: DESOLUS gothic portal puzzler launches on PC, Switch 2, and consoles
items.summary: Mark J. Mayers／Quantum Astrophysicists Guild《DESOLUS》已喺 10 月 15 日登陸 Steam、Switch 2、PS5 同 Xbox Series：第一人稱哥德風傳送門解謎，用黑洞／傳送門喺過去同未來之間修復一座艾雪式城市。
items.note: Launch Oct 15; missed prior batch. Switch 2 confirmed via GoNintendo/Games Press. publishedAt date-only midnight HKT.
items.imageAlt: DESOLUS Steam capsule art

items.title: RATATAN leaves Early Access; launches on Switch 2, PS5, Xbox, and PC
items.summary: 節奏動作《RATATAN》已於 10 月 15 日結束 Early Access 並正式發售，平台包括 Switch 2、PS5、Xbox Series 同 Steam。早前由 7 月延期至今。
items.imageAlt: RATATAN Steam capsule art
items.note: Also listed in Gematsu weekly JP releases and Nintendo upcoming Oct list. Not in yesterday batch. publishedAt date-only midnight HKT.

items.title: Steam Achievement Sets enter beta to group base-game and DLC trophies
items.summary: Valve 喺 Steam Client beta 推出 Achievement Sets：開發者可將成就分組（例如本體同 DLC 分開），完成後唔會因後加內容失去「全集」狀態。
items.imageAlt: Steam logo

items.title: Footage leaks from reportedly cancelled Assassin's Creed Destiny set in China
items.summary: VGC 報道疑似已取消嘅《Assassin's Creed Destiny》原型影片流出，背景係秦朝中國。報道指同仍在開發嘅手機作 Jade 唔係同一項目；Ubisoft 未正式確認。
items.imageAlt: Assassin's Creed Codename Jade related promo art
items.note: Leak/report of cancelled prototype; not an official Ubisoft confirmation. Image may be Jade-related stock from VGC og:image.

items.title: Street Fighter 6 free Movie EX Colour codes for Zangief, Honda, Dhalsim
items.summary: 配合新《Street Fighter》電影上映，Capcom 放出 SF6 免費 Movie EX Colour 兌換碼（含 Switch 2），需已擁有對應 Outfit 2。喺選項「Input event code」兌換。
items.imageAlt: Street Fighter 6 Movie EX Colours promo

items.title: Micromania offering Ocarina of Time Switch 2 replica N64 box in France
items.summary: 法國 Micromania 午夜開賣《薩爾達傳說：時之笛》Switch 2 重製時，預購顧客可限量獲贈 N64 風格複刻盒（非完全複製品）。EB Games Canada 亦有類似紙套。
items.imageAlt: Ocarina of Time Switch 2 replica N64 box promo

items.title: Nintendo raises Switch 2 and Switch repair prices in Japan from November 16
items.summary: 任天堂日本公告：由 11 月 16 日起調高 Switch 2／Switch 維修參考價，理由係零件成本上升。例如 Switch 2 CPU 基板維修由 27,500 円加至 37,400 円。
items.imageAlt: Nintendo Switch 2 hardware photo
items.note: Japan-only for now; controllers/accessories not revised per report.

items.title: HorrorVale: Deadluxe Edition dated October 31 for consoles and Switch
items.summary: Electric Airship／BatWorks 恐怖 RPG《HorrorVale: Deadluxe Edition》定 10 月 31 日登陸 PS5／Xbox／PS4／Xbox One 同 Switch。PC 版 2024 年已出。
items.imageAlt: HorrorVale Deadluxe Edition console artwork

items.title: Heavy Metal Death Can now available on PS5 and Xbox Series
items.summary: Krufs Productions 復古生存恐怖《Heavy Metal Death Can》而家喺 PS5／Xbox Series 發售，定價 $17.49。背景係瑞典冷戰潛艇，Steam 版 5 月已出。
items.imageAlt: Heavy Metal Death Can console release art

items.title: Brave Dungeon + Dark Witch's Story: COMBAT coming to PS5 October 24
items.summary: Inside System 地下城 RPG 合集《Brave Dungeon + Dark Witch's Story: COMBAT》定 10 月 24 日登陸 PS5。
items.imageAlt: Brave Dungeon Dark Witch COMBAT PS5 art

items.title: Squad coming to PS5 and Xbox Series in 2027; free PS5 alpha Oct 16–25
items.summary: Secret Mode／Offworld 宣布戰術 FPS《Squad》2027 年登陸 PS5 同 Xbox Series，跨平台多人。免費 PS5 alpha 由 10 月 16 日至 25 日開放。
items.imageAlt: Squad console announcement art
items.note: Full console release year 2027 only; alpha window Oct 16–25 2026.

items.title: Modern Warfare 4 DMZ Early Access starts October 20 for digital pre-orders
items.summary: 官方確認《Modern Warfare 4》DMZ 提早體驗 10 月 20 日起開放畀數位預購／預購 Standard 或 Vault Edition 玩家，平台包括 Xbox、PS5、PC 同 Switch 2。戰役 EA 已喺 16 日開始。
items.imageAlt: Modern Warfare 4 DMZ Forward Operating Base art
items.note: Guide dated Oct 9 but Xbox Wire Oct 16 amplified; EA start Oct 20 is the news hook. Campaign EA already in yesterday batch—this item focuses on DMZ EA. publishedAt uses Oct 16 Xbox Wire day midnight HKT.

items.title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse launches on consoles, Switch, and PC
items.summary: Konami《Castlevania: Belmont's Curse》已於 10 月 15 日發售，平台包括 PS5、Xbox Series、Switch、Steam 同 Xbox on PC。係 Belmont 系列新作狩獵夜間威脅。
items.imageAlt: Castlevania Belmont's Curse key art
items.note: Launch day Oct 15; not in yesterday gaming batch. publishedAt date-only midnight HKT.

items.title: PlayStation Plus October catalog: Mafia: The Old Country, Mycopunk, Dino Crisis 2
items.summary: PS Plus Extra／Premium 10 月目錄公布：包括《Mafia: The Old Country》、《Mycopunk》、經典館《Dino Crisis 2》等；多數地區 10 月 20 日可玩。另有遊戲試玩。
items.imageAlt: PlayStation Plus October 2026 catalog artwork
items.note: Announced Oct 14 (edge of 48h); catalog drops Oct 20 so still actionable. Not in yesterday batch.

items.title: ANTONBLAST launches on PS5 and PS4
items.summary: 幽默動作平台《ANTONBLAST》已於 10 月 15 日登陸 PS5 同 PS4。Gematsu 報道確認主機版同日推出。
items.imageAlt: ANTONBLAST PlayStation release art
items.note: Article Oct 13 evening UTC / launch Oct 15; within ~48h of Sat morning HKT. Not in yesterday batch.

items.title: Ken Kutaragi says he understands fans' attachment to physical PlayStation games
items.summary: 「PlayStation 之父」久夛良木健接受 VGC 訪問，話明白玩家對實體碟嘅執著，但認為持續出碟唔夠經濟合理，並指數位擁有感係心態問題。
items.imageAlt: Ken Kutaragi at Game Horizons event

items.title: Activision QA testers vote to authorize strike ahead of MW4 launch
items.summary: CWA 宣佈 Activision Publishing QA（Locals 6215／7250／9400）以壓倒性票數授權罷工，指首輪合約談判超過兩年仍卡喺薪酬同穩定性；時間點喺 Modern Warfare 4 發售前。
items.note: CWA release dated around Oct 15–16; publishedAt date-only midnight HKT.
items.imageAlt: Communications Workers of America share image
